x_note: SMC controller data (Documents/Notes/Controllers/DieuKhien_SMC.txt). Ts_ctrl: controller period [s]. Integral SMC (ISMC): s = Ts_dot_hat + 2*lambda*e_T + lambda^2*z, T_a = T_a_max * sat(s / Phi). Slotine anti-windup: z integrates e_T inside boundary layer (|s| <= Phi) and freezes outside (|s| > Phi).
